assets.description: Large dark-brown-and-muted-gold framed illustration of exactly one fallen aged-white sashimono. Revision 21 restores all interior cuts and holes, leaving a continuous intact white cloth panel with broad natural folds. Damage is confined to restrained missing corners, edge-connected tears and light white fraying around the outer perimeter; no burn marks or brown scorched rims. Broken rope-lashed timber palisades, collapsed rails and a little dry grass remain softly rendered in the background. No fire, smoke or embers. Transparent exterior; no second flag, hat, arrows, lettering or clan crest. The icon does not replace the unit affiliation flag.

runtime_integration: Artwork handoff only. Revision 23 replaces only the three fire_loading exports with an enlarged muzzle-and-ramrod close-up plus one dominant ivory diagonal slash with a deep-brown outline, marking loading/unavailable to fire; no hand is shown and the insertion junction is unobscured. fire_loading.png remains the preferred 512x256 runtime texture. The unchanged fire_ready icon remains a horizontal complete matchlock. Both display using the full canvas at 240x120 in one mutually exclusive shooting-status slot with no assigned coordinates. The other six asset entries and eighteen PNGs, all display sizes and placement guidance are unchanged, including the candidate routed size and unresolved position. Hosted URLs, cache refresh, agreed state behavior, placement and overlap handling belong to the code side; TTS runtime rendering is unverified.
notes: Revision 23 changes only fire_loading: an enlarged muzzle-and-light-wooden-ramrod close-up crops out the stock and breech, and one prominent ivory slash with a deep-brown outline descends opposite the barrel to make loading/unavailable to fire distinct. The muzzle-ramrod junction remains uncovered; there is no hand. Matte ivory plaque styling, all canvas dimensions and exterior alpha boundaries are retained. The other six asset objects and their eighteen PNGs are unchanged.

fire_ready.png and fire_loading.png are the preferred 512x256 runtime textures; the corresponding -240x120.png files are display-size convenience exports; both sources are 1024x512. Use the full canvases at 240x120 without trimming transparent padding. The pair shares one mutually exclusive shooting-status slot; no placement coordinates, new state triggers or reset rules are assigned.

Revision 23 remeasured the three fire_loading exports for RGBA mode, pixel dimensions, alpha>0 and alpha>=128 bounds, transparent padding and SHA-256. The corresponding alpha channels match the unchanged fire_ready exports pixel-for-pixel at all three sizes. The other six asset objects and their eighteen PNG bytes match the pre-revision-23 HEAD. No new preview or overview image was generated; overview points to standalone fire_ready.png. TTS runtime, front/back rendering, distance, angle and overlap remain unverified.

Historical revision 22 introduced fire_ready and fire_loading as matte ivory plaques with dark-brown borders. fire_ready showed a horizontal complete Japanese tanegashima; the original fire_loading showed a raised complete musket with a lighter wooden ramrod inserted into the muzzle and no hand. Revision 23 supersedes that loading composition; fire_ready remains unchanged.

Revision 21 repairs every interior routed cloth slit and puncture. Only perimeter tears, missing corners and restrained white fraying remain. Natural folds, the soft palisade background, single fallen white banner and frame are retained. The other four asset entries and their PNGs are unchanged; all display-size and placement guidance is unchanged.

routed.png is 1200x800, routed-600x400.png is the display-size export, and the source is 1536x1024. Candidate display size is 600x400 on a 1200x1200 board; no coordinates or automatic elevation logic are assigned. The rounded alpha outline removes outside background remnants; Box area downsampling retains a narrow antialiased edge.

Revision 21 generated no new preview or overview image; its overview reference pointed to standalone routed.png. Commander overlap, front/back rendering, distance and oblique-angle readability still require code-side and TTS validation; the artwork alone does not prevent occlusion.

Revision 12 changes only out_of_command: an ivory-white diagonal slash with a dark-brown outline replaces the black slash with a pale outline. The charcoal gunbai, dark vermilion background, matte finish, clean outer ring, 100x100 display size and placement are retained. The other three icons and their asset entries remain unchanged.

Revision 11 makes both formation plaques taller and increases the vertical row spacing in formation_open. The six same-scale markers, 2:1 canvases and existing mutually exclusive 240x120 candidate placement are retained. Box area downsampling and matching regular alpha boundaries retain narrow antialiasing.

Use engaged.png and out_of_command.png (512x512) as the preferred circular runtime textures at 100x100 UI size, and formation_close.png and formation_open.png (512x256) at 240x120. Existing placement is unchanged. The display-size files are convenience exports. Upload/replacement of hosted Steam URLs and cache refresh belong to code-side integration; no TTS runtime validation has been performed.

All earlier engaged, out_of_command and combined previews are historical and do not represent the current artwork. No new preview or overview was produced; overview points to standalone fire_ready.png.

Both circular badges retain the revision 10 edge cleanup: matching regular circular alpha boundaries, dark outer lines and matte pale-gold bands. Revision 12 gives the charcoal gunbai an ivory-white slash with a dark-brown outline. Same-size alpha channels are pixel-identical. Box area downsampling retains narrow antialiasing.

At 240x120, both formation plaques have alpha>0 bounds (2,8)-(238,112), 104px high; their alpha>=128 visible height is 102px, increased from 88px in revision 9. Same-size alpha channels match pixel-for-pixel.
Formation marker check: each 512x256 PNG contains six comparable-scale markers; the vertical separation of row centers is approximately 70px in formation_close and 89px in formation_open.
At alpha>0 the circular exports have uniform transparent margins: 15px at 1024x1024, 7px at 512x512, and 1px at 100x100. Both badges retain a narrow antialiased edge.

The engaged badge uses a 100x100 canvas at (20,56), centered at (70,106). The out_of_command badge uses a separate 100x100 canvas at (892,56), centered at (942,106). Both can appear simultaneously; do not reuse one mutually exclusive display slot.
The right badge is placed beyond the rightmost title boundary x=885 exclusive, leaving a 7px title gap and a 6px right-frame gap. No existing title needs to move or shrink.
Cloud URLs intentionally empty; no runtime-hosting URLs have been provided.
Only the area outside each circular badge is transparent; both badge interiors are solid.
At a 300px-wide board each 100px placement becomes 25px; final readability requires TTS distance and angle testing.
Back previews are charcoal contrast/layout illustrations, not captured or reconstructed TTS backs.
This handoff defines artwork and placement only, not automatic state detection, timing, persistence, or reset rules.
